# Every key of the `HostClassDecl` JSON the SDKs send the poll core, one per
# line, `section.key` for the nested declarations. Two readers pin it: a
# `flz_core` test serialises a fully populated declaration and asserts its key
# set is exactly this, and `HostClassDeclarationTest` asserts the Java builder
# emits every key here. A key the core learns that Java cannot spell is a red
# Java build; a key Java invents that the core never learned already fails at
# `deny_unknown_fields`.
#
# Adding a key: teach the core, add it here, teach the Rust builder and the Java
# builder — one change, every SDK (docs/architecture/runner.md).
class.factory_id
class.schema_version
class.persistent
class.sdk_lang
class.change_format_id
class.effectively_once
class.ack_granularity
class.checkpoint_every
class.checkpoint_outputs
class.checkpoint_max_delay_ms
class.correction_window_ms
class.beyond_window_policy
class.compact_after_bytes
class.sync_durability
class.channels
class.procedures
class.workflow
channel.name
channel.kind
channel.producer
channel.consumers
channel.retry_max
channel.retry_backoff_ms
channel.overflow
channel.keyed
procedure.name
